description_en: Modifies the resource group to which a Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance or a bandwidth plan instance belongs
description_zh: 调用MoveResourceGroup接口修改云企业网实例或带宽包实例所属的资源组
kebab_example: aliyun cbn move-resource-group --new-resource-group-id rg-aekzqqurtfg0000 --resource-type cen --resource-id cen-nye53d7p3hzyu40000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MoveResourceGroup

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

The client generates the value of this parameter. Make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system uses RequestId as ClientToken. The value of RequestId may be different for each API request
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to perform a dry run. Valid values:
true: performs a dry run without modifying the resource group of the CEN instance or bandwidth plan instance. The system checks the required parameters, request syntax, and business restrictions. If the check fails, the corresponding error is returned. If the check succeeds, the error code `DryRunOperation` is returned.
false (default): performs a dry run and sends the request. If the check succeeds, an HTTP 2xx status code is returned and the operation is performed
parameters.help_zh:
是否只预检此次请求。取值：
true：发送检查请求，不会更改云企业网实例或带宽包实例所属的资源组。检查项包括是否填写了必需参数、请求格式、业务限制。如果检查不通过，则返回对应错误。如果检查通过，则返回错误码`DryRunOperation`。
false（默认值）：发送正常请求，通过检查后返回HTTP 2xx状态码并直接进行操作
parameters.name: dry_run

parameters.help_en: The ID of the new resource group
parameters.name: new_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource type. Valid values:

cen: CEN instance.
bandwidthpackage: bandwidth plan instance
parameters.help_zh:
资源类型。取值：

cen：云企业网实例。
bandwidthpackage：带宽包实例
parameters.name: resource_type
